description: This file defines the SDT class within the WPEFramework::Broadcast::DVB namespace, representing a Service Description Table (SDT) for DVB streams. It includes nested classes for iterating over services, constants, and methods for accessing SDT data such as service IDs, running modes, and descriptors.

classes.name: SDT
classes.description: Represents a DVB Service Description Table, providing access to service information within a transport stream.

classes.name: SDT::ServiceIterator
classes.description: Iterator class for traversing services listed in the SDT, providing methods to access service properties and descriptors.

methods.name: SDT::ServiceIterator::Next
methods.description: Advances the iterator to the next service in the SDT.

methods.name: SDT::ServiceIterator::ServiceId
methods.description: Returns the service ID of the current service.

methods.name: SDT::Services
methods.description: Returns an iterator over the services contained in the SDT.

methods.name: SDT::OriginalNetworkId
methods.description: Returns the original network ID associated with the SDT.
